name: How do I choose the right paint finish for my interior walls?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right paint finish for my interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting the appropriate paint finish depends on the room's function and desired aesthetic. Flat or matte finishes hide imperfections well and are ideal for low-traffic areas like bedrooms and dining rooms. Eggshell and satin finishes offer more durability and a subtle sheen, making them suitable for living rooms and hallways. Semi-gloss and high-gloss are the most durable and easiest to clean, perfect for kitchens, bathrooms, and trim, though they tend to highlight wall imperfections. Consider the level of light exposure and how frequently the surface will need cleaning when making your decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose paint finish based on room function and desired look. Flat/matte for low-traffic, eggshell/satin for common areas, and semi-gloss/high-gloss for durability in kitchens, baths, and trim.
